subject: Contract Assurance Playbook kickoff — SOC 2 scope, pen-test window & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@greenwell.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract Assurance Playbook kickoff — SOC 2 scope, pen-test window & evidence handoff

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for moving this forward. Per our legal team's request I want to kick off a short "assurance playbook" thread so we have a single source of truth for scope, access, and delivery cadence tied to the MSA/Order Form redlines. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm the SOC 2 report you intend to share (Type II, date range) and the preferred transfer mechanism (S3 link with short-lived creds vs. Secure Share)
- Confirm your preferred pen-test window (range of dates). We typically ask for a 2-week window with a single 24–48hr high-intensity test day and a follow-up validation week.
- Provide the list of Greenwell contacts that need read-only access for evidence upload and the identity provider (Okta, Auth0, internal SSO)
- Any restrictions on third-party contractors performing testing (we have an approved pen-test vendor list)

Attached: our suggested redlines to the MSA (section on audit access / pen testing) and a draft access matrix to make handoffs easier. Can you confirm whether your security team prefers us to sign an amendment for a special-assurance clause or accept the redline language in the current Order Form?

Proposed next steps
- You confirm SOC2 artifact transfer method and pen-test target dates by EOD Tue (20 Apr)
- Kickoff call Wed 21 Apr 10:00am PT to align scope and responsibilities
- We prepare an assurance runbook (read-only S3, access TTLs, contact matrix) and send prior to the call

Appreciate it — I’ll loop in Legal if we need formal amendment language.

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlined_MSA_v3.pdf (pdf, 247KB)]
[Attachment: assurance_access_matrix.csv (csv, 12KB)]

From: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@greenwell.health>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: techops@greenwell.health, Derek Price <derek.price@greendevops.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract Assurance Playbook kickoff — SOC 2 scope, pen-test window & evidence handoff

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: Type II, coverage Jan 2026—Dec 2026. We can provide a secured S3 export with pre-signed URLs that expire after 72 hours, or we can push to your SFTP if you prefer.
- Pen-test window: tentative window 07–21 May; primary testing day we prefer 13 May. We need to coordinate with our clinical ops blackout windows on 12–14 May for change freeze.
- Contacts: compliance@greenwell.health is the primary intake; Derek (copied) will act as our DevOps lead for test coordination and temporary creds.
- Third-party testers: Greenwell requires that external testers be sponsored by our security contact and approved in advance — we can run a quick POA for your vendor if needed.

We reviewed your MSA redlines at a high level — two notes: 1) we prefer clarifying that pen-tests are mutually agreed and scheduled so there’s a single point of escalation for emergency changes; 2) our legal asked to restrict the scope of audit access to production logs for the 30-day window surrounding the test.

I’ll attach our draft pen-test scope workbook and a short checklist for evidence handoff so we have alignment before the call. Can we do 21 Apr at 10:00am PT?

Samantha
Samantha Holt
Director, Security & Compliance
Greenwell Health
[Attachment: pen-test-scope-draft.xlsx (xlsx, 86KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract Assurance Playbook kickoff — internal runbook & asks

Team — looping you in with Samantha's replies. Action items from Legal/Deals/Tech Ops POV: 

1) Legal redline note: Samantha's team wants audit access restricted to production logs 30 days around the test. Laura — can Legal propose language that preserves our right to request expanded scope for specific forensic needs while giving them the 30-day default? See attached example clause I drafted.

2) Pen-test vendor: we need to confirm if Greenwell will sponsor our vendor or if they expect them to be approved separately. Marissa — please pull our approved pen-test vendor list and supplier insurance certs; send to Derek before EOD Tue.

3) Evidence transfer: our preference is S3 with short-lived put creds created per session (assurance_ingest role). Stephanie — can Ops prepare a script and TTL policy (recommended 72h presigned puts + lifecycle policy)? Target to publish to the shared drive by Tues 20 Apr COB.

4) MSA language: Rafael — if Greenwell prefers an amendment, we should prepare an Order Form amendment (Assurance Addendum) rather than broadening the core MSA. That keeps negotiation localized.

I’ll draft the internal runbook (roles & responsibilities, access matrix, contact list) and post to the Drive. Rafael — will you confirm the call time with Samantha?

Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: suggested_assurance_clause.txt (txt, 4KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@greenwell.health>, techops@greenwell.health
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract Assurance Playbook kickoff — SOC 2 scope, pen-test window & evidence handoff

Samantha / Derek —

21 Apr 10:00am PT works for us. Agenda for the 30-minute call:

- Confirm SOC2 handoff mechanism and S3 vs SFTP decision (5m)
- Finalize pen-test window and blackout constraints (10m)
- Agree evidence upload workflow & TTLs + who sponsors the vendor approval (10m)
- Next steps: Order Form amendment vs inline redlines, and timeline for artifact delivery (5m)

Deliverables we’ll have ready before the call:
- Draft assurance runbook (roles & contact matrix) — shared Drive link below
- Redline MSA + proposed Order Form amendment language (if needed)
- Ops TTL policy and short script to create presigned put URLs

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B7-assurance/GW-1973-playbook
Proposed amendment stub (if helpful) is in the Drive: GW-1973_Assurance_Addendum_draft.docx

If Greenwell confirms S3 with 72h presigned puts, we can provide credentials scoped to a single prefix so you can audit uploads. On vendor sponsorship: we are happy to provide our vendor packet (insurance, scope limits) — Marissa will send that to Derek today.

If Legal needs to redline the clause that limits logs to 30 days, Laura — please prepare alternative language that keeps our escalation path intact.

See you on the call.

Best,
Rafael
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B7-assurance/GW-1973-playbook]
